intro: Nip 'Em in the Bud is a mission directed by Earthseer Farsen to eliminate Dark Iron spies infiltrating Dun Morogh. The clandestine operatives have been spotted lurking near Ironband's Compound, threatening the security of the Bronzebeard homeland.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' not sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.
Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
